title: THINGS-EEG2: A large and rich EEG dataset for modeling human visual object recognition
description: THINGS-EEG2 is a large EEG dataset from 10 participants who viewed 16,540 training images and 200 repeatedly presented test images from the THINGS database. Images were shown in rapid serial visual presentation at 5 Hz while 63-channel EEG was recorded at 1000 Hz across four sessions per subject. The dataset supports modeling of human visual object recognition and includes resting-state recordings, the authors' preprocessed epochs, and stimulus images.
methods_description: EEG was recorded with a BrainVision actiCHamp system (63 channels, 10-10 layout, 1000 Hz, online band-pass 0.01-100 Hz). Each of four sessions per subject had 5 training runs, 1 test run, and 2 resting-state runs. Stimuli were presented by RSVP at ~200 ms SOA, with random target catch trials requiring a button press.
